title: Rig
description: A rig: animator controls turned into deformer values (joint transforms, morph target weights, curves), in stages like MetaHuman's RigLogic. Controls are clamped to their range; each value maps a control through a piecewise-linear curve; each combination is the product of earlier values; each output adds weight * value (or the given offsets times the value) to its target. Every name a value, combination or output refers to must be defined (controls, then values, then combinations, in order), and every joint and morph must exist in the model.

default.description: 0 when absent (or min, if 0 is out of range).

values.description: A control through a piecewise-linear curve: [[input, output], ...] with increasing inputs; constant beyond the ends.

combinations.description: The product of two or more earlier values (correctives: shapes that fire only together).

joints.description: Joint offsets per unit of a value, added to the joint's rest transform: translation in the joint's parent space, rotationEuler (degrees, X then Y then Z) after the rest rotation, scale added to the rest scale.

morphs.description: A morph target's weight: the sum of weight * value over its entries.

curves.description: Extra named outputs (for example wrinkle-map masks): the sum of weight * value over its entries.
